Primary drivers: improve chat latency for in-app assistant, reduce embedding unit costs for similarity search, predictable costs for enterprise customers. Decision criteria: latency at 95/99th, predictable unit economics, SOC2+ SSO, EU data residency for enterprise accounts.

POC/Technical: wants to run a POC using Hosted API first (fast onboarding), then pilot Dedicated if unit economics and SLOs meet targets. Current infra: GCP us-central1 with replicas; average payloads ~300 tokens, tail lengths up to 2k for longer transcripts. Target perf: 99th pct latency < 500ms for short-turn chat, sustained 1k qps for embeddings pipeline (batch-friendly).

Cost Workshop notes (3/09):
- Attendees: Maya (AE), Carlos (SE), Eng mgr Priya, backend lead Jamal, Finance lead Sara.
- Outcome: agreed to run two sets of experiments in POC:
  * Batching profiles: small-batch low-latency (24-64 tokens), workload-aware batching for peak hours; large-batch for overnight embedding ingestion
  * Caching: prefix/KV caching for recurring prompts (templates + user context), expected 12-18% token reduction in steady-state 
  * Quantization profiles: evaluate int8 / 4-bit variants supplied by Redwood Optimize on Dedicated; target ~2-3x throughput improvement vs fp16 with <2% quality degradation on our prompts
  * Unit economics modeling: Redwood to provide per-token and per-embedding estimates for both Hosted and Dedicated under proposed batching/caching configs; finance wants 6-12 month payback-assumptions
